en.text:
Only works with a <solar/>Solar Super Ability equipped.

Reaching Critical Health consumes your Class Ability to spawn a <solar/>Sunspot under you.

Manually casting your Class Ability also spawns a <solar/>Sunspot under you.

The spawned <solar/>Sunspot grants the Sol Invictus buff even without having the Aspect equipped. (The Aspect is still required to extend the sunspot's duration)
